name.value: The Canterbury Inn of Downtown Invermere

description.value: The Canterbury Inn is a motel in downtown Invermere, a town on the western shore of Lake Windermere at the foot of the Rocky Mountains in southeastern British Columbia. It offers single, double, and family room configurations and sits close to regional draws including Panorama Mountain Resort, Radium Hot Springs, and Kootenay National Park trails. The inn's central location in Invermere puts touring cyclists within easy reach of local dining, shops, and the Columbia Valley Trail corridor.

raw_osm.name: The Canterbury Inn of Downtown Invermere

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at invermerecanterburyinn.ca confirms the address (747 12th Street, Invermere, BC) and presents as an operational motel with a booking widget and three room categories (Single, Double, Family Bedroom), but large portions of the site — including all room descriptions and all feature descriptions — consist of lorem ipsum placeholder text, limiting what can be verified. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; Wi-Fi is indicated only by the OSM tag internet_access=wlan, which cannot be confirmed via website content per the rules. The website self-identifies as 'Canterbury Inn' rather than the OSM name 'The Canterbury Inn of Downtown Invermere'.
concerns: Website contains extensive lorem ipsum placeholder text throughout all room descriptions and all feature descriptions — the site appears to have been built from a template and never properly populated, limiting verifiable content.
OSM name 'The Canterbury Inn of Downtown Invermere' does not match the website name 'Canterbury Inn'.
Contact page postal code appears malformed: 'VDA 1K0' (likely should be 'V0A 1K0').
No phone number available in OSM tags or anywhere on the website.
Blog posts dated 2018 are template placeholder content, not real editorial posts.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible motel at a confirmed address in downtown Invermere with an active booking widget; the heavily placeholder website is a concern but not grounds for exclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wi-Fi is indicated by OSM tag internet_access=wlan but could not be confirmed from website content; marked null per rules. No cyclist-specific amenities could be confirmed due to the placeholder nature of most website content.
